Ethiopian Rebel Groups Form New Alliance

Seven Ethiopian rebel groups have formed a new alliance, stating they will work together. These groups have been active in Ethiopia's most populous regions for years. Former adversaries among the groups say they will settle their differences, amid growing fears of an expanding war in Ethiopia.
